name: claude-context-size-guard
description: Context-size guard for Claude Code. Measures live context on every prompt and tells you to run /compact before an over-full turn is billed.

plugins.name: claude-context-size-guard
plugins.description: Stops you from sending a prompt into an already-bloated context. UserPromptSubmit hook: past a configurable token threshold (default 75,000), Claude answers with a one-line notice to run /compact instead of burning a full turn.
